key_highlights: Oil nears $100/barrel as Saudi infrastructure attacked and US-Iran conflict escalates; India crude benchmark also tops $100, driving record Labor Day fuel prices
Bond market under severe stress: 10-year Treasury at ~4.8%, global issuers racing to lock in funding before further yield spikes; Bessent's debt buybacks adding volatility
US jobs report added 162,000 (3x expectations), intensifying Fed rate-hike fears; CVC Marathon says equities can absorb 25bps hike but market is nervous
Yen climbs to 6-month high as rate differentials shift; Morgan Stanley says carry trades can still withstand yen strength
Trade tensions escalate: Trump threatens to ban Bombardier jet sales as Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect; tariff relief for Nike/Starbucks described as fleeting
Tech/AI momentum continues: Apple new CEO launch Sept 9, Jensen Huang values 1GW AI facility at $50-60B, South Korea power demand soaring on AI boom
Novartis shares fall most on record, dragging European stocks; Oracle faces EU regulatory warning ahead of earnings
Latin America leads EM FX gains ahead of US CPI; India IPO pricing at 1,700-1,785 rupees; Millennium nears $100B AUM
Silver holds above $66 on safe-haven demand; gold paradoxically dips on fresh Iran escalations (liquidity-driven selling)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (US-Iran conflict, Kyiv war extending to 2027)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain 10-15% energy/commodity allocation; hold gold/silver as hedges; avoid overexposure to Middle East-linked shipping and defense-adjacent names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond market dislocation and rising yields (10Y ~4.8%)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favor floating-rate and short-duration credit; avoid long-duration growth equities without earnings visibility; lock in CD rates at 4.35%

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike risk (25bps) on strong jobs data
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; favor cash-flow-positive equities; monitor CPI release this week as key catalyst; CVC Marathon suggests 25bps absorbable but market reaction uncertain

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Canada trade war escalation (Bombardier ban threat)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to Canadian-listed industrials and aerospace; monitor retaliatory tariff expansion; favor domestic-manufactured alternatives

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI/tech IPO overhang forcing portfolio rebalancing
risk_assessment.mitigation: Anticipate rotation out of existing mega-cap tech into AI-lab IPOs (Anthropic); avoid overconcentration; watch SpaceX Nasdaq 100 weighting impact

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Regulatory and operational risks (Oracle EU, data breaches, food collusion)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from single-name regulatory exposure; monitor Oracle earnings closely; avoid companies under active antitrust probes

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy equities and commodity producers (oil, silver, copper)

opportunities.rationale: Rates elevated and likely to stay higher; 10Y at 4.8% makes cash competitive; reduces equity drawdown risk in volatile environment

opportunities.recommendation: Position for AI infrastructure and power demand beneficiaries

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce long-duration growth equity exposure; shorten bond duration
defensive_moves.rationale: 4.8% 10Y yield and potential 25bps Fed hike create headwind for duration-sensitive assets; bond market on edge signals further volatility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim or hedge Canadian-listed industrials/aerospace exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump Bombardier ban threat and retaliatory tariffs create binary downside risk; tariff relief for multinationals described as fleeting

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 5-10% gold/silver allocation as geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Iran conflict ongoing, Kyiv war extending to 2027; silver >$66 shows safe-haven bid; gold dip on escalations may be temporary liquidity-driven

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid overconcentration in single tech names ahead of AI-lab IPOs
defensive_moves.rationale: Anthropic and similar IPOs may force 'make room' selling; SpaceX Nasdaq 100 weighting shift creates index rebalancing pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to consumer discretionary and retail names
defensive_moves.rationale: Record fuel prices, tariff costs, and mall closures signal consumer squeeze; beverage brand Chapter 11 after Costco loss shows fragility

market_outlook.short_term: High volatility expected. Oil at $100 and Iran conflict create upside risk to inflation, complicating Fed path. US CPI release this week is the pivotal catalyst. Bond market stress and 4.8% 10Y yield cap equity multiples. Yen at 6-month high may trigger carry-trade unwinds. Apple launch Sept 9 and Oracle earnings provide idiosyncratic catalysts. Net: cautious, range-bound with geopolitical tail risk.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (Jensen Huang $50-60B/GW) supports structural tech demand. EM divergence continues with LatAm/India outperforming. Higher-for-longer rates favor value, financials, and energy over growth. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, tariffs) reshapes supply chains. 401(k) record savings and 529 plan adoption signal strong household balance sheets. Kyiv war into 2027 keeps defense and energy premium intact.
